meta.title: Session Enhance
meta.description: Inspect any session and all of its subagents by ID (plus a title-bar copy-ID button), share a session as a read-only link, retry a turn the user interrupted (the official Continue action covers model failures only), run an "off-peak session" that pauses during DeepSeek peak time and resumes automatically during the off-peak window (toggle at the top right), and use Claude Code-style tiered context compaction (auto/manual, toggleable in settings).
